title: Embedded Systems Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Embedded Systems Technician Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Students will acquire skills necessary to program common microcontrollers using C.
Students will gain familiarity with different communication protocols to interface between electronic systems.
Students will be proficient at using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and spectrum analyzers to analyze circuits.
Students will acquire the skills necessary to methodically identify problems in circuits and propose solutions.

blocks.name: Required Prerequisite Robotics Technician Certificate of Achievement (12-13 Units)

notes: The Requirements tab prints two totals: 'Total Units 12-13' for the required prerequisite Robotics Technician Certificate of Achievement and 'Total Units 11' for the Required Courses. total_units 23-24 is taken from the Program Sequence grid ('Total Units 23-24'), which the page describes as a map 'to finish all requirements for the certificate'. If only the courses beyond the prerequisite should count, the total would be 11.

The prerequisite Robotics Technician certificate courses are recorded as a block because the page lists them under 'Required Prerequisite' and the state closed list includes them. A reviewer should confirm whether they belong to this award or to the separate Robotics Technician certificate.

ELEC A100 is printed with '3-4', which appears to reflect its alternatives (MATH A115 or MATH A120). The alternatives MATH A115, MATH A120 and ELEC A290 have no units printed beside them in the requirements list, so their units are null.

Careers left empty: the description mentions only 'a career working with embedded electronics commonly found in consumer devices, IoT-connected devices, and autonomous vehicles' and names no specific job title.
Spelling 'Technition' appears in the Program Sequence note as printed.
